subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: Should maintainers accept pre-fix production logs plus positive/negative unit coverage as sufficient proof for this non-inducible xAI/Grok rotation error?
rationale: The contributor says the exact code-less xAI error only appears when xAI rotates the model snapshot/key, while the normal real-behavior proof gate requires after-fix evidence unless maintainers explicitly override it.

options.title: Accept Proof Override
options.body: Allow merge after branch refresh and normal checks because the code path is source-reproducible, the retry machinery already exists, and the exact provider trigger is not client-inducible.

options.title: Require Organic After-Fix Logs
options.body: Keep the PR waiting until a real xAI/Grok rotation happens again and the contributor can attach redacted recovery logs.

options.title: Pause The PR
options.body: Leave the fix unmerged if maintainers want a broader provider-error classification design before changing this predicate.

recommendation.title: Accept Proof Override
recommendation.body: Allow merge after branch refresh and normal checks because the code path is source-reproducible, the retry machinery already exists, and the exact provider trigger is not client-inducible.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent openai-responses replay PRs were merged by steipete, making this the best available owner for a proof-gate override decision.
